note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 after TestOSPFNSSABorderRouterDefaultPBit gained RFC3101-2.4-7 tags; its assertions are unchanged. ComputeExternalWith performs both step (3) skips for a border router: P-clear default (prefType7P0) and NoSummary policy. v4 and v6: positive 'summary import suppressed' asserts no route for a P-set default; the 'P-bit clear' subtest in the same unit asserts no route for a P-clear default with summaries imported; negative 'P-bit set' requires the one default route; TestOSPF(v3)NSSANonBorderRouterInstallsPClearDefault shows a non-border router installs a P-clear default under suppression, so both conditions bind a border router only. Removing either skip or the border-router guard reddens a distinct assertion. Records are whole-body reverts of ComputeExternalWith.
